name: Grañén (Spain)
description: Dark blue field with a white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the arms of Grañén (a tower and a fox on blue with the bars of Aragon) beneath a crown of ears of wheat.
history: Municipal flag of Grañén; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
